name: feature-flags
title: Feature switches (no-deploy on/off)
summary: Database-backed switches that turn a feature on or off on the next request, with no deploy. Off by default.
when: Something must open or close at a moment you choose (sales, registrations, a form, a new payment method), or be built and shipped dark.
next: Apply the new migration, then add a row per switch (see packs/feature-flags/README.md).
List switches the browser may ask about in PUBLIC_SWITCHES in api/features.ts.
